lines.t: Beloved ones, I have spoken a multitude of words in your hearing
And I have given a shout and poured out my spirit
Behold, I have whispered into the ears of this generation
To every man, woman, and child
Yet who gave heed, who stood up and proclaimed my coming
Who among men stood firm for who I truly am
Who bowed down and gave me glory
Who among this great multitude fell on their faces in true repentance
Who among those who say they are
My people sought to make their repentance full
Yeah, the little children gave heed
The hearts of the little ones skipped a beat
They alone embraced my voice for they remember
And seek to return to the place from whence they came
Yet this foolish and most wicked generation
Spies me in their zeal and refuse to give heed
Plugging their ears when I called, turning their backs when I drew near
Thus I removed my spirit from the people
And drew back my hand from the multitude
And they were forsaken, that they might stumble
That they might fall, that they might reap all
They have sown in their arrogance, suffocating on account of their greed
Until they drown in the depths of their vanity to their own shame
For I tell you the truth, that which is tipped cannot be set up right again
And that which has been set in motion cannot be stopped low
Even that which was held captive in the depths of silence has been released
Behold, it comes forth, increasing by order of magnitude
And can in no wise be put back again
Says the Lord
Oh, oh, oh, oh
Thank you.
